name: Riverdale Summer Recreation Camp
description_short: Five week borough recreation camp at the Riverdale Community Center for Riverdale residents, full time for children entering grades 1 to 6 and part time for grades 7 and 8, with bus trips to places like bowling alleys and rec days at the center and school fields.
notes: Riverdale residents only. 9 am to 3 pm; no camp Friday July 3. The cost is shared among campers and set after registration closes: $250 due April 17, $250 due May 15, and a final amount (announced by May 15) due June 1, 2026. The 5 week program cost $675 per child in 2025. Runs rain or shine. Not a school sponsored program.
